releaseNotesKm: រូបរាងថ្មី។ ពណ៌សំខាន់មួយឆ្លុះគ្រប់កន្លែងក្នុងកម្មវិធី។ ទំព័រប្រតិទិនខែមានចំណងជើងខែហើយ។ ការរាប់ថយក្រោយឆប់រំកិលហើយ។
releaseNotesEn: A new visual identity: a dark theme designed as its own palette, a neon accent that now reaches every part of the app, and secondary colours derived from whichever accent you pick. The month screen finally shows which month it is. The countdown no longer shifts as its digits tick.
